summary: Frontend-only test of new CAD label editing UX. Verified floating toolbar (Edit/A−/A+/✕), inline editor, double-click, empty-delete, font_size grow/shrink with clamp, undo/redo, Save & Sync persistence (font_size persists across reload), and updated Manual 'Editing labels' subsection. All criteria in the review request PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: CadEditorTab.jsx is ~1633 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting: label sub-components, tool handlers, and history hook into separate modules for maintainability.
The label toolbar buttons (edit/grow/shrink/delete) do not call e.stopPropagation on click. It works currently because the outer div stops propagation, but nested handlers relying on that is fragile.
seed_data_creation: Created one label 'KITCHEN'→renamed 'BEDROOM' with font_size=2.1 in the existing TEST_iter39_bp project (then deleted at end of test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Label editing shipped correctly. Floating toolbar renders via absolute positioning inside the canvas container using vb-based percentage transforms. font_size flows through the blueprint save endpoint (labels: List[dict] in /app/backend/models/blueprint.py) with no backend changes needed. Test observed: fs=1.5 default, +0.25 A+, -0.25 A−, clamp 0.6 lower bound confirmed (upper bound 6 not explicitly hit but code path Math.min(6,...) is straightforward).

detailed_results.save_and_sync_persists_text_and_font_siz: PERSISTED: BEDROOM, font_size='2.1' after full page reload
detailed_results.undo_redo_labels: Undo restored deleted label, second undo reverted BEDROOM→KITCHEN, redo replayed correctly
detailed_results.manual_editing_labels_subsection: Present under CAD Editor; mentions double-click, floating toolbar, A−/A+, ✕
